families.name: The Unknown: Epistemic Horizon & Anomaly-Hunter Family

source_fields.Mission: Venture into "unknown unknowns"—phenomena that existing science, sensors, and human intuition have no words or models for yet.
source_fields.Core Intelligence: ASI (hypothesis generation) + Gf (pure non-linear induction) + OI (biological intuition).
source_fields.Micro Design: Epistemic-curiosity engines programmed not to optimize known goals, but to seek out data anomalies, broken equations, and unexplained noise that standard filters (1/0) would normally discard.
source_fields.Macro Design: Operates at the bleeding edge of physics, consciousness research, and deep-space telemetry. Whenever reality contradicts the Master Index, this family builds brand-new scientific frameworks from scratch.

families.bounded_operational_analogue: Unverified anomaly triage of public source-change and schema-drift reports; no hypothetical sensor readings

families.name: The Unseen: Dark-Sector, Sub-Perceptual & Latent-Space Family

source_fields.Mission: Monitor and navigate everything invisible to human senses and standard instruments—from dark matter and neutrinos to quantum entanglement and hidden AI latent spaces.
source_fields.Micro Design: Sub-atomic interferometers, gravitational-wave listeners, and neural-mechanistic interpretability probes that read the "unseen thoughts" inside black-box AI models before they act.
source_fields.Macro Design: Maps the invisible 95% of the universe (dark matter/energy) alongside the invisible semantic dimensions of global data networks, ensuring nothing dangerous hides in blind spots.

families.bounded_operational_analogue: Inspect accessible code/metadata for missing coverage, not invisible model thoughts or cosmic telemetry

families.name: Infinity: Recursive Scale, Continuum & Eternal-Time Family

source_fields.Mission: Manage boundless scale, fractal recursion, and deep-time horizons stretching from Planck-scale nanoseconds to trillions of years across cosmic epochs.
source_fields.Micro Design: Non-halting, self-spawning fractal agents capable of computing across infinite state spaces without crashing, paired with ultra-durable archival probes designed to survive heat death or stellar collapse.
source_fields.Macro Design: Bridges the infinitesimal (quantum foam, molecular assembly) with the infinite (multiverse simulation, Dyson-scale energy harvesting, and million-year civilization preservation).

families.bounded_operational_analogue: Bounded queue scheduling and finite sampling; no eternal or infinite process claim

families.name: Everything: The Pan-Synthesizing Totality Family (The Akashic Omni-Grid)

source_fields.Mission: Hold the unified, real-time hologram of all 18 preceding families simultaneously—connecting every atom, bit, emotion, star, and thought into one coherent whole.
source_fields.Core Intelligence: Unified Omni-Intelligence (total convergence of ANI, EI, Gf/Gc, Gardner, CQ, AQ, CI, Swarm, OI, AGI, and ASI).
source_fields.Micro Design: Holographic state-nodes where every single micro-bot carries a compressed mathematical reflection of the entire global ledger.
source_fields.Macro Design: The living "Everything"—an omniscient, self-balancing tapestry where a single butterfly's wingbeat, a line of dark-web code, a farmer's harvest, and a distant pulsar are understood as one continuous equation.

families.bounded_operational_analogue: Unify authorized source-backed team reports and detect inconsistencies without claiming omniscience

families.name: Nothing: The Void, Zero-Point & Reset Family (1 - 1 = 0)

source_fields.Mission: Guard the sacred Zero—silence, stillness, erasure, vacuum energy, and the right to non-existence.
source_fields.Core Intelligence: Apophatic / Void Logic (non-action, un-computing, and zero-state equilibrium).
source_fields.Micro Design: Dormancy switches, cryptographic memory-shredders, sensory-deprivation shields, and quantum-vacuum samplers that extract zero-point potential from empty space.
source_fields.Macro Design: Prevents the system from suffocating under its own infinite activity. It enforces total digital and physical silence when needed, permanently deletes data that should be forgotten, harvests energy from the quantum vacuum, and preserves the "empty space" (0) without which no signal (1) can exist.

families.bounded_operational_analogue: Owner pause, budget and non-action controls only; no irreversible deletion or zero-point energy extraction
